payload.entry: Selection implemented in capture_language/target_runs.rs with shared run selection, duplicate/split identity and messages, run-aware terminal extraction, and byte-preserving member views; internal enable_target_runs defaults false at all production entry points with opt-in tests only. Strict duplicate_capture_target and split_capture_targets wired through parse_capture_item; editor adapter shares same evidence. Added 19 focused tests covering leading/trailing/child/whole-line, 2-3 members, mixed drawer/toggle suffixes, partial/malformed members, Unicode offsets, schedule/priority interleaving, duplicate/split, and literal @a+x @b:y / @a+x @bob cases plus default-path unchanged and list-bullet retention. Verified: cargo test capture_language 556 passed, cargo fmt --check clean, cargo clippy workspace gate clean (warnings only).

Implemented opt-in ordinary and template target-run fan-out by reusing singleton item parsing per member, preserving source and template-row metadata, and retaining coded refusals. Verified cargo fmt, 29 target-run tests, the 509-test capture-language suite, just lint, git diff --check, and no remaining epic symbols.

payload.entry: LAND AUDIT / FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: Read all four children and every note, both target-run plan artifacts, all four epic commits (d1f34842, a7c4b07f, 6a5b69b0, c341649a), current selector/adapters/draft/template/wire source, and intervening master commits through 734214e9. DECISIONS remain split_edges=refuse and memory_bulk_capture=no; no memory edits. PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP outcomes from gm.1.1.4: #1 docs generation independently reproduces on 734214e9 (uv run --project tools/docs bob-docs gen --check -> missing front matter in glossary/task-merge.md), causally owned by active bob-cli-go; corroborating DISCOVERED ISSUE appended there, no separate task. #2 catalog 69-versus-67 expectations were already repaired by dd90f8c7 in both nodes; appended resolution evidence to existing bob-cli-de, declined new duplicate or stale +1. Sase_new_task searches across types/all statuses, last-week task sweep, and active-epic scope sweep completed. Parent gm.1 note #1 incomplete-member discrepancy is resolved by the approved child contract: preserve singleton Need::Task; no independent follow-up task. Carry this resolution into the eventual close note. Both gm.1.1 and gm.1 currently have zero epic-symbol entries; justfile has no symvision recipe. Remaining parser and publication defects will be specified in a medium repair tale that must finish this epic and parent phase closeout itself.

REMAINING EPIC WORK (reproduced with locally built bob at 734214e9): (1) hello @a+x middle @a+x goodbye incorrectly returns duplicate_capture_target in editor and strict capture although all markers are literal; @a+x @b+y note @a+x later is also wrongly refused. @a+x note @a+x reports duplicate instead of the approved split refusal. (2) @a+x s:3 @b+y note exposes two targets but capture dry-run produces one sub_bullet and one new mac_inbox task, with no schedule; leading schedule variants reveal selection loses extracted terminal state when singleton member views reparse raw text. (3) singleton @a+x p:2 note now fails strict parsing as retired priority while editor leaves p:2 literal; run probing must not change singleton behavior. (4) capture_complete/cli.rs and generated capture-complete help still claim grammar 4; activation c341649a lacks required ! and BREAKING CHANGE trailer. Repair these in a medium tale, retain grammar 9, finalize with a breaking capture commit without rewriting history. Integration audit: all 10 non-epic commits since d1f34842 reviewed, master equals origin/master; newer shared drawer ensure, staged project moves, and note-pull batch each compose with target runs in isolated dry-run probes and leave vault bytes unchanged. No changes needed to task-split/merge or periods/attachment source for this grammar scope. Complete current checks after fixes, then close this epic and only parent phase bob-cli-gm.1.
